lead: The order that works: **understand, practise, repeat, test.**
Kaamyab tarteeb: **samjhein, practice karein, dohrayen, test dein.**
steps: **Plan**: set your exam date and the minutes you have each day. The page then gives you today's work.
**Plan**: exam ki date aur rozana ke minute set karein. Phir page aaj ka kaam khud batata hai.
**Notes**: read one section until you could explain it to a friend.
**Notes**: ek section parhein, itna ke kisi dost ko samjha sakein.
**Study**: answer the questions of the same section.
**Study**: usi section ke sawal karein.
**Labs**: do the lab of the section, if it has one. What you've clicked yourself stays in your head.
**Labs**: section ki lab ho to karein. Jo khud kiya ho woh yaad rehta hai.
**Practice**: 10 to 20 mixed questions, and read every explanation, also when you were right.
**Practice**: 10 se 20 mile jule sawal, aur har explanation parhein, jawab sahi ho tab bhi.
**Flashcards** every day: only the cards that are due.
**Flashcards** rozana: sirf woh cards jin ki bari aayi ho.
**Mock exam** once a week, then **Weak areas**.
Hafte mein ek **Mock exam**, phir **Weak areas**.
tip: Short and daily beats long and rare: 45 minutes every day is better than 5 hours on Sunday.
Thora aur rozana behtar hai: har din 45 minute, Itwar ke 5 ghanton se ache hain.

lead: Don't just read: **ask, answer, write.**
Sirf na parhein: **poochein, jawab dein, likhein.**
steps: First look at the headings under *On this page*. Ask yourself what you know already.
Pehle *Is page par* ki headings dekhein. Khud se poochein kya pehle se pata hai.
Read slowly, one heading at a time. After each one, look away and say it in your own words.
Aahista parhein, ek waqt mein ek heading. Har ek ke baad nazar hata kar apne lafzon mein kahein.
The boxes: 💡 **Example** shows the rule at work, 📍 **Where** is the portal menu, ⚠️ **Trap** is what the exam likes to ask.
Boxes: 💡 **Misaal** mein rule kaam karta dikhta hai, 📍 **Kahan** portal ka menu hai, ⚠️ **Jaal** woh jo exam poochta hai.
Answer the *Check yourself* questions **before** you open the answer.
*Khud ko parkhein* ke sawal ka jawab **pehle** khud dein, phir kholein.
Write three lines on paper: the rule, one number, one trap.
Kaghaz par teen lines likhein: rule, ek number, ek jaal.
Tick *I have read this section*. It counts in your Plan.
*Maine yeh section parh liya* tick karein. Plan mein gina jata hai.
Read the tables at the bottom last, and come back to the section after a few days.
Neeche ki tables aakhir mein parhein, aur chand din baad section par wapas aayen.
tip: Lost? Use the search: it looks in all 29 sections.
Kuch dhoondna ho to search karein: tamam 29 sections mein dekhta hai.

lead: For learning, without marks or time.
Seekhne ke liye, number aur waqt ke baghair.
steps: Choose a section. Start with the level *Basic*, then *Inter* and *Adv*.
Section chunein. Pehle level *Basic*, phir *Inter* aur *Adv*.
Read the question and **decide on an answer** before you press *Show answer*.
Sawal parhein aur *Jawab dikhayen* dabane se pehle **apna jawab tay karein**.
Read why the right option is right **and why the others are wrong**. That's where the exam points are.
Parhein ke sahi option kyun sahi hai **aur baqi kyun ghalat**. Exam ke number wahin hain.
Clear? Tick *I understand this*. Hard? Press ☆ and find it later under *Bookmarked*.
Samajh aa gaya? *Mujhe samajh aa gaya* tick karein. Mushkil? ☆ dabayen, baad mein *Bookmarked* mein milega.
*Not understood yet* shows what is left, *My quiz mistakes* what you answered wrong.
*Abhi samajh nahi aaye* baqi sawal dikhata hai, *Meri quiz ghaltiyan* ghalat jawab wale.
*Concept questions* test the idea itself. Do them before the long scenarios.
*Concept wale sawal* asal baat parakhte hain. Lambe scenarios se pehle yeh karein.
tip: Still unclear after the explanation? Open the Microsoft Learn link under it.
Explanation ke baad bhi samajh na aaye to us ke neeche Microsoft Learn ka link kholein.

lead: Short daily revision. The app decides when a card comes back.
Rozana ki choti revision. Card kab wapas aaye, app tay karti hai.
steps: In Study choose *Flashcards*. Press `F` for full screen.
Study mein *Flashcards* chunein. Full screen ke liye `F`.
Say the answer, then press `Space`.
Jawab bolein, phir `Space` dabayen.
Rate honestly: `1` **Again** didn't know, `2` **Hard** knew with effort, `3` **Good** knew at once.
Imandari se rating dein: `1` **Again** nahi aata tha, `2` **Hard** mushkil se aaya, `3` **Good** foran aaya.
*Again* comes back in this round. *Hard* and *Good* come back after days, and the gap grows each time.
*Again* isi round mein wapas aata hai. *Hard* aur *Good* kuch din baad, aur waqfa har dafa barhta hai.
Every day: the filter *Due for review*, until it's empty.
Rozana: filter *Review ke liye due*, jab tak khaali na ho jaye.
`←` `→` move between cards without rating, `S` shuffles. On a phone, swipe.
`←` `→` rating ke baghair card badalte hain, `S` shuffle. Phone par swipe karein.
tip: An honest *Again* helps more than a kind *Good*.
Imandar *Again*, narm *Good* se zyada faida deta hai.

lead: Answer, check, learn. Every answer is explained at once.
Jawab dein, check karein, seekhein. Har jawab ki explanation foran.
steps: Pick one domain after reading its notes; later mix all five.
Notes parhne ke baad ek domain chunein; baad mein paanchon milayen.
10 to 20 questions are enough for one sitting.
Ek baithak mein 10 se 20 sawal kaafi hain.
Answer with `A`–`E` or `1`–`5`, `Y` / `N` for statements, and `Enter` to check and go on.
Jawab `A`–`E` ya `1`–`5`, statements ke liye `Y` / `N`, aur check aur aage ke liye `Enter`.
For every mistake ask: *didn't I know it, or did I read it wrong?* The two need different cures.
Har ghalti par poochein: *pata nahi tha, ya ghalat parha?* Dono ka ilaj alag hai.
Tick *Only questions I got wrong last time* to clear your mistakes.
Ghaltiyan khatam karne ke liye *Sirf woh sawal jo pichli baar ghalat hue* tick karein.
tip: Aim for **80% and more** in a section with at least 10 answers. Plan then marks it.
Section mein kam se kam 10 jawab ke sath **80% ya zyada** ka hadaf rakhein. Plan usay mark kar deta hai.

lead: A rehearsal. Treat it like the real thing.
Asal exam ki rehearsal. Bilkul asal samajh kar dein.
steps: Choose **50 questions, timed**. Phone away, no notes, full screen (`F`).
**50 sawal, timed** chunein. Phone door, notes band, full screen (`F`).
Read the **last sentence first**: what is asked? Then the rest, looking for words such as *minimum cost*, *least privilege*, *least administrative effort*.
**Pehle aakhri jumla** parhein: kya poocha hai? Phir baqi, aur *minimum cost*, *least privilege*, *least administrative effort* jaise lafz dhoondein.
Strike out what can't be right, then choose. Not sure? Choose anyway, press `M` **Mark for review**, and go on.
Jo sahi nahi ho sakta usay nikaalein, phir chunein. Shak ho to bhi chunein, `M` **Review ke liye nishaan** dabayen, aur aage barhein.
About **2 minutes** per question. Halfway through the time you should be past half of the questions.
Har sawal par taqreeban **2 minute**. Aadha waqt guzre to aadhe se zyada sawal ho chuke hon.
On the review screen open the marked and unanswered questions. **Never leave one empty.**
Review screen par marked aur khaali sawal kholein. **Koi sawal khaali na chhorein.**
In problem-solution sets you can't go back, and parts close when you leave them.
Problem-solution sets mein wapas nahi ja sakte, aur part chhorne par band ho jata hai.
Afterwards read **every wrong answer**, then practise the weakest domain the same day.
Baad mein **har ghalat jawab** parhein, phir usi din sab se kamzor domain ki practice.
tip: Ready for the exam: two or three mocks in a row above **800**, and no domain below 70%.
Exam ke liye tayyar: lagatar do teen mocks **800** se upar, aur koi domain 70% se kam nahi.

lead: What Microsoft says about the exam (checked on 26 November 2026).
Microsoft exam ke bare mein kya kehta hai (26 November 2026 ko check kiya).
steps: **100 minutes** (120 if it has labs), usually 40 to 60 questions, pass mark **700 of 1000**. 700 isn't the same as 70%.
**100 minute** (labs hon to 120), aam tor par 40 se 60 sawal, pass **1000 mein se 700**. 700 ka matlab 70% nahi.
**No points are taken off** for wrong answers, and most questions with several parts give a point per correct part. Answer everything.
Ghalat jawab par **number nahi kat-te**, aur kai hisson wale aksar sawalon mein har sahi hisse ka number milta hai. Sab ka jawab dein.

**Online**: check in from 30 minutes before. Government ID whose name matches your profile exactly, a closed room, an empty desk, no second monitor, phone out of reach. Run the system test days before.
**Online**: 30 minute pehle se check in. Government ID jis ka naam profile se bilkul mile, band kamra, khaali mez, doosra monitor nahi, phone door. System test kai din pehle karein.
**Microsoft Learn is open** during the exam, but the clock keeps running. Use it for one or two details, not for learning. Q&A and practice assessments are blocked.
Exam mein **Microsoft Learn khula hota hai**, lekin waqt chalta rehta hai. Ek do tafseel ke liye, seekhne ke liye nahi. Q&A aur practice assessments band hain.
**Breaks** are allowed and the clock runs on. Questions you saw before the break can't be opened again, so finish them first.
**Break** le sakte hain, waqt chalta rehta hai. Break se pehle dekhe sawal dobara nahi khulte, is liye pehle mukammal karein.
**Try the sandbox** beforehand (aka.ms/examdemo): it shows every type of question.
Pehle **sandbox** azmayen (aka.ms/examdemo): har qism ka sawal dikhata hai.
**Not passed?** Wait 24 hours, after that 14 days between attempts, five attempts in 12 months. **Passed?** Renew every year, free and online.
**Fail ho jayen?** 24 ghante rukein, phir har koshish mein 14 din, 12 mahine mein paanch koshishein. **Pass?** Har saal free aur online renew.
tip: The last evening: only the cheat sheet, then sleep. In the exam, the first thought is often right; change it only for a reason.
Aakhri shaam: sirf cheat sheet, phir neend. Exam mein pehla khayal aksar sahi hota hai; wajah ho tabhi badlein.

lead: Real work in Azure Cloud Shell, with your own test subscription.
Azure Cloud Shell mein asal kaam, apni test subscription ke sath.
steps: Set a **budget alert** first, and look at the cost label of the lab.
Pehle **budget alert** lagayen, aur lab ka cost label dekhein.
Open the portal, click `>_` and choose Bash. Run one step at a time.
Portal kholein, `>_` par click karein aur Bash chunein. Ek waqt mein ek step.
Before each command, say what it will do. After it, find the result in the portal.
Har command se pehle kahein yeh kya karegi. Baad mein portal mein nateeja dhoondein.
An error? Read it. Finding the cause is exam practice.
Error aaye? Parhein. Wajah dhoondna exam ki practice hai.
Run **Clean up the same day** and check that the resource group is gone.
**Cleanup usi din** chalayen aur dekhein ke resource group khatam ho gaya.
tip: Finishing a lab ticks *Lab done* for its skills in your Plan.
Lab mukammal karne par Plan mein us ki skills par *Lab ki* lag jata hai.

lead: Work where the points are missing.
Wahan kaam karein jahan number kam hain.
steps: Open *Weak areas* after every practice set and take the lowest subtopic.
Har practice ke baad *Weak areas* kholein aur sab se neeche wala subtopic lein.
Read its notes again, then practise only that subtopic.
Us ke notes dobara parhein, phir sirf usi subtopic ki practice.
Clear your open mistakes before you learn new things.
Naya seekhne se pehle purani ghaltiyan khatam karein.
Use the **cheat sheet** in the last two weeks: ten minutes a day, one topic.
**Cheat sheet** aakhri do hafte: rozana das minute, ek topic.
tip: A weak domain with a high weight (identity, compute) gives the most points back.
Zyada weight wala kamzor domain (identity, compute) sab se zyada number wapas deta hai.

lead: Small things that save time.
Choti baatein jo waqt bachati hain.
steps: `?` lists the keyboard shortcuts, `F` is full screen, `I` light or dark, `L` English or Roman Urdu, `H` this guide.
`?` keyboard shortcuts ki list, `F` full screen, `I` light ya dark, `L` English ya Roman Urdu, `H` yeh guide.
After the first visit the app also works **offline**. When a new version is ready, a message at the bottom offers it.
Pehli dafa ke baad app **offline** bhi chalti hai. Naya version tayyar ho to neeche paigham aata hai.
Your progress is saved **only in this browser**. Export it on the Dashboard once a week, and before you clear browser data.
Progress **sirf isi browser** mein hai. Hafte mein ek dafa Dashboard se Export karein, aur browser data saaf karne se pehle bhi.
To continue on another device, import that file there.
Doosre device par jari rakhne ke liye wahan woh file Import karein.
tip: The content is original and based on Microsoft Learn; it isn't an exam dump. When in doubt, Learn decides.
Mawad original hai aur Microsoft Learn par mabni; exam dump nahi. Shak ho to Learn ki baat maanein.
